name: Mara Detron
tradeable: unranked only, no Forma or Catalyst

conditions: Crack Void Relics, then trade the Prime parts for Ducats.

groups.activity: buy it on a visit that stocks it
groups.meta: every two weeks for 48 hours; stock rotates

rows.label: Mara Detron
rows.note: arrives built and ready to equip; no Foundry step

conditions: Baro's stock changes each visit, so it may be missing on the next one.
bonuses: It's separate Mastery from the base Detron and the Tenet Detron; owning the Tenet doesn't cover it.

disclosures.title: other routes
disclosures.body: During TennoCon, Baro's special Relay is open to anyone with a ticket, and his stock there covers almost everything he has sold.

disclosures.title: manual trigger
disclosures.body: It's semi-auto and out-fires your clicking once fire-rate mods are on. Enable the setting to fire manual-trigger weapons continuously, or bind fire to the mouse wheel.
